questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “For example, a scientist knows that the value of the _____ is 20V.”

hints.nudge: The missing word names one thing, not an action. The words on each side of the gap show what kind of thing fits.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Find all values in the circuit” part of the Ohm's law article.

questions.proof: For example, a scientist knows that the value of the voltage is 20V.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Current has to do with _____ flowing in a circuit.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “flowing”. It names more than one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Current” part of the Ohm's law article.

questions.proof: Current has to do with electrons flowing in a circuit.
